entities.name: Russell W. Porter
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Russell Williams Porter was an American artist, engineer, architect, cartographer, amateur astronomer, and Arctic explorer. He was a pioneer in the field of cutaway drawing and is sometimes referred to as the "founder of amateur telescope making."
